svg.title: Player board GREEN advanced
svg.text: GREEN - ADVANCED SIDE - moving prices, Ports open two goods
Your home tile has a Dock:
you can trade iron and bots there.
Gain 3 Credits + 1 per land tile you hold.
Take the coins off your buildings (they can work again).
Extractor: take 1 token of the tile's resource
Factory: 1 iron = 2 Bots, or iron + crystal = 1 Mech
Move any pieces together: 1 Credit per step
Iron and crystal only travel with a Bot (one at the start and one at the end).
Trade at your Dock or a Port next to a tile you hold
Buy a Mission (+1 for each you have bought)
Each item bought moves its price up 1, each item sold moves it down 1 (stay inside the range).
You cannot buy and sell the same good in one turn. A Port opens only the two goods on it.
A coin on a building = used this turn.
